Nogometni klub Slaven Belupo, often referred to as Slaven Belupo, is a Croatian professional football club based in the city of Koprivnica in the north of Croatia. They play their home matches at Gradski Stadion in Koprivnica. They compete in the Croatian Football League (HNL), the top tier of Croatian football.
